主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announces specific share repurchase programs as part of its normal course issuer bid. The announcement is included in the press release filed with the SEC on January 11, 2018. The bank's share repurchase programs are part of its ongoing strategy to return value to shareholders. The details of the repurchase programs are outlined in the press release. The repurchase programs are subject to market conditions and the availability of funds. The bank's management believes that the repurchase programs are in the best interests of its shareholders. The repurchase programs are not intended to be a substitute for dividends. The bank's management will continue to evaluate its capital allocation strategy and may adjust the repurchase programs as needed. The repurchase programs are subject to the approval of the bank's board of directors. The bank's management will provide further details on the repurchase programs in the future.
